hook_candidates.headline: Your AI costs are about to rise
You're paying too much for AI
AI pricing changes in 2026
hook_candidates.sub: Here's what you need to know

caption:
Just got a notification that Microsoft Copilot is now $10/month for non-enterprise users. That's a 4x price jump from the previous $2.50 tier.

If you're using AI for client proposals, content, and research (like most freelancers), you'll need a plan that doesn't cost more than $10/month. Here's a breakdown of real pricing that matters to you:

ChatGPT: $20/mo (for $20/mo, you get full GPT-4 access and unlimited use)
Claude: $20/mo (for $20/mo, you get full Claude 3.5 Sonnet access)
Gemini: Free (for non-enterprise use, but limited to Gemini 1.5 Pro)
Copilot: $10/mo (for non-enterprise, including GPT-4 access)

Use this prompt when you're comparing tools for your next project:

'Compare AI tools with these needs: [Your Need]. Prioritize price under $10/month, then speed, then features.'

Copy and paste this prompt. You'll save 30+ minutes each time you're choosing a tool for a client project.

Save this for when you need to choose a tool. If you use it, you'll avoid wasting $10+ per month on a tool that's too expensive for your needs.
